description: Gap analysis — whether price gaps will be filled and how to trade them
context: User asking about price gaps (up/down) and gap-fill probability.
user_input_examples: 跳空缺口一定会回补吗？
向上跳空缺口没回补，现在还能追吗？

structure.suggestion: Trading approach based on gap type

key_principles: Breakaway gaps (start of trend, high volume): least likely to fill quickly
Runaway/continuation gaps (mid-trend, normal volume): may partially fill
Exhaustion gaps (end of trend, extreme volume): most likely to fill within days
Gap size matters: gaps >5% on individual stocks have >70% partial fill rate within 20 days
Common gaps (no news/catalyst): fill within 3-5 days ~80% of the time

decision_tree.if_breakaway_gap_with_volume_surge: Do not wait for fill, enter on next pullback to gap edge
decision_tree.if_exhaustion_gap_after_long_rally: Expect fill, take profit or set tight stop
decision_tree.if_common_gap_no_catalyst: Wait for fill before entering new position
